claim_provenance.claim: Activate forecasts footnote-defined global Consumer Internet and Media Revenues to rise from $1.7 trillion in 2017E to $2.0 trillion in 2021E, with $302 billion growth and a 4.1% CAGR versus approximately 3% for global GDP.
Activate forecasts global Consumer Internet and Media Revenues at $2.0 trillion in 2021E.

In Activate’s global 2017E–2021E forecast, Cost of Internet access, including fixed broadband, wireless, and mobile Internet access, is projected to increase by $128B, the largest dollar increase among the three listed revenue segments, and to have the highest CAGR at 5.7%.

In the U.S. in 2017, the top 25% of users with 4.5+ hours of daily video attention accounted for 61% of total video time spent and 34% of total consumer spend, while all other users accounted for 39% of video time spent and 66% of consumer spend.
In Activate’s 2017 study, 34% of podcast non-listeners (n=700) selected “Knowing which apps to use” as a factor that would lead to podcast listening.
